name: Haiku quality compounders
strategy: Quality dividend and value compounders positioned for rising-rate environment; energy carry on geopolitical inflation; financial sector capture of higher net interest margins; 20% dry powder.
reassessment_note: Fed pivot to rate HIKES (57% probability, Chair Warsh hawkish, 10-year at 4.80%) requires reposition from 40% cash underweighting. Previous leg's light financials (+0.50%) and dividend positioning misaligned with higher-rate tailwinds. Energy thesis validated (XLE +6.45%). Rotating to: (1) dividend compounders (SCHD) capturing higher sustainable yields; (2) value factor (VTV) outperforming in rate-hike cycle; (3) financials (JPM, XLF) with widening NIMs; (4) quality healthcare compounder (UNH -6.20% presents entry); (5) energy hold for carry. Reducing cash to 20% to participate in market upside as rate expectations stabilize. Maintains <50% same-direction overlap with Round 2 (27.5% overlap: JPM 7%, UNH 8%, BRK.B 7% only).

positions.thesis: Energy sector benefits from geopolitical tensions, elevated crude oil, and persistent inflation. Outperformance thesis validated: XLE +6.45% on leg. Carry positioning captures structural support from supply constraints and rate environment pricing oil risk premium.

Financials should compound at accelerated rates in 4.8% yield environment. Previous leg underweighted despite +0.50% move indicates market repricing nascent. Each 25bps rate cycle adds ~$1B+ earnings across sector. Quality mega-banks like JPM separately weighted for direct margin capture.

High-quality dividend compounders with pricing power and 15+ year dividend raise streaks. In 4.8% yield environment, 3.2% dividend yield supports reinvestment compounding. Quality funds capital into businesses with durable moats, fortress balance sheets, and proven capital discipline.

Value factor outperforms in rising-rate environment as duration sensitivity reverses growth premium. Fed Funds Futures now price 57% hike probability; market rotation away from duration-sensitive mega-cap growth to value compounders with ROE-driven returns. VTV holds quality value compounders across sectors.

Tier-1 mega-bank with 14%+ historical ROE, directly captures net interest margin expansion. 4.8% 10-year yield supports 5%+ NIM environment; each 25bps move adds ~$75M annual pretax earnings. Strong capital position funds 3.5%+ dividend yield and buyback compounding. Fortress balance sheet defines quality mandate.

Quality healthcare compounder down -6.20% on Round 2 leg despite 22% ROE and pricing power. Healthcare defensively compounds through economic cycles. Integrated care model and scale generate durable moats. Current drawdown presents compounder entry at normalized valuation; dividend grower with 15+ year track record.

Conglomerate quality compounder: Buffett's capital allocation historically delivers 15%+ long-term returns through insurance float deployment and strategic M&A. Fortress balance sheet with $180B+ in cash supports dividend growth. Diverse earnings streams compound across rate cycles.

High-yield dividend compounders (3.5%+ dividend yield) focused on mid-cap quality payers. In higher-yield environment, dividend-supported total returns compound through reinvestment into businesses with pricing power. Diversified across sectors to capture broad capital allocation discipline.
